class.name: FlowEndNode
class.brief_description: Ends a [FlowGraph], or returns from a [FlowSubgraphNode].
class.description: The end node has one flow input port, [code]in[/code], and no outputs. When the execution reaches it, the graph is finished. The optional [member end_name] tells the caller which end was reached, which is useful when a graph has several ends, for example a dialogue with different outcomes. When a graph runs as a [FlowSubgraphNode], its end nodes are where it returns to the calling graph. At runtime the node ends the graph: [signal FlowGraphPlayback.finished] is emitted with the id of this node and the playback stops playing. Inside a [FlowSubgraphNode] it only ends the inner graph; the outer graph continues at the output of the subgraph node that matches [member end_name] (see [member FlowSubgraphNode.exit_names]), or at [code]out[/code]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var end_node := FlowEndNode.new() end_node.end_name = &"won" graph.add_node(end_node) [/gdscript] [csharp] var endNode = new FlowEndNode { EndName = "won" }; graph.AddNode(endNode); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The name of this end. It is shown in the graph node and is available to the playback to tell which end was reached. May be empty.
